ebitda.missingEntry: {count, plural, one {# consultant record has} other {# consultant records have}} no start date: EBITDA counts them from record creation. Set it on the record.
ebitda.method: Time & materials revenue = approved timesheets × sold rate; fixed price = budget by approved-day progress. Salaries and fees prorated to presence; current month: fixed costs prorated to elapsed working days, revenue and freelancers actual to date. "Pending" = logged but unapproved timesheets, outside EBITDA.

formula.title: How it's computed
formula.line1: Max day cost = sold rate × (1 − margin) × occupancy
formula.line2: Max gross salary = max day cost × working days ÷ (1 + charges)
